# KarKo AI

> AI-powered job application assistant that generates complete, tailored job applications in under 90 seconds.

## What is KarKo AI?

KarKo AI is a web-based tool that helps job seekers apply to jobs faster and smarter. It uses agentic AI to analyze job descriptions, optimize CVs for ATS compatibility, generate tailored cover letters, and draft professional application emails — all from a single job posting paste.

## Key Features

- **One-Click Applications**: Paste a job description and get a complete application package (optimized CV + cover letter + email) in under 90 seconds.
- **AI CV Optimization**: Tailors your CV to match each job description while preserving your authentic experience. No hallucinated skills.
- **Smart Fit Analysis**: Scores your match against job requirements, identifies gaps, and provides honest assessments.
- **Cover Letter Generation**: Creates personalized, human-sounding cover letters that reference specific company details.
- **Application Email Drafting**: Professional emails ready to send with your application.
- **Master CV Support**: Upload a comprehensive Master CV for better AI-powered tailoring.
- **Multi-Language Support**: Works with job descriptions in English, German, and other languages.
- **ATS-Friendly Output**: All generated CVs are optimized for Applicant Tracking Systems.

## How It Works

1. Upload your CV (PDF or DOCX)
2. Paste a job description
3. Choose: Analyze First (fit assessment then generate) or Apply Directly (full generation)
4. Review and download your optimized CV, cover letter, and email

## Pricing

- **Free Plan**: 40 credits (~20 applications/month), no credit card required
- **Plus Plan**: $29.99/month — 200 credits, priority processing
- **Pro Plan**: $49.99/month — 500 credits, advanced AI models, premium support

KarKo AI publishes expert articles on CV optimization, cover letter writing, job search strategies, and how AI is transforming the hiring process. Visit https://www.karkoai.com/blog for the latest articles.

## Technical Details

- Built with Next.js, React, and TypeScript
- Uses advanced AI models (Claude, GPT-4) for document generation
- Real-time streaming progress with agentic workflow
- Secure: CVs are processed in-memory, not stored permanently
- GDPR compliant

## Target Users

- Job seekers applying to multiple positions
- Career changers needing CV adaptation
- International job seekers (multi-language support)
- Anyone who wants to save time on job applications
